# Waffle Guide
> An independent consumer guide to Waffle House menu items, typical price ranges, nutrition estimates, locations and diner culture. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Waffle House, Inc.

## Menu & Prices
- [Full Menu & Prices](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/menu): 88 menu items across 15 categories with typical prices, calories, protein, carbs, fat, sodium and allergens.
- [Menu PDF](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/menu/pdf/): Where to find Waffle House nutrition information online and how to print our menu guide.
- [Prices by State](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/prices-by-state): Typical prices and the range of prices seen at different restaurants, and why prices vary across the 25 states.
- [Coupons & Deals](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/coupons): Ways to save, including the free Regulars Club email program. No promo codes are listed.

## Nutrition & Diet
- [Nutrition Facts](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/nutrition): Calorie, protein, carb and fat estimates by menu category, with a hashbrown bowl calculator.
- [Calories & Allergens](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/waffle-house-calories-allergies/): Calorie comparisons and allergen guidance, including shared-kitchen cross-contact notes.
- [Dietary Guide](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/waffle-house-dietary-guide/): How to compare calories, protein, carbs, sodium and allergens for different dietary goals.
- [Low-Calorie Menu](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/diet/low-calorie/): 50 dishes under 600 calories, ranked lightest first.
- [High-Protein Menu](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/diet/high-protein/): 41 dishes with 20g of protein or more, ranked by protein.

## Visiting & Events
- [Locations & Hours](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/locations): A selection of Waffle House locations across the 25 states where the chain operates (more than 2,000 restaurants in total); most are open 24/7.
- [Catering Guide](https://www.wafflehouse-menu.com/waffle-house-catering/): Catering formats (delivery, on-site stations, food truck) and how to request them.

## Notes
- Prices, nutrition figures and availability are estimates compiled by our editorial team. They vary by location and change over time.
- For orders, employment or corporate inquiries, use the official Waffle House website: https://www.wafflehouse.com
